rv.t: 단편 판타지 만화 보는 느낌. 최소 2회차 하면서 각 분기 이야기 보는 재미가 있음. 좀 더 유기적으로 얽힌 이야기와 게임성이 있었다면 하는 아쉬움이 들지만 짧게 할만해서 추천함

Well that was adorable as heck. It's a very short game, I was expecting a lot more. I hope they expand it and make it into a full game. I would play a full game. But for a free game, I had a great time!
Devclerk PLEASE make a longer version of this. It takes the gameplay of something like Papers Please and adds it's own style to it. The style itself is cool, being 2d sprites in a 3d space.
Interesting idea, but too cute by half. There's no tension because of it.
